# Groovy lexer and parser from IntelliJ IDEA Community Edition

This directory holds the Groovy lexer and parser of IntelliJ IDEA Community Edition, adapted so that they run on the
IntelliJ core that `org.jetbrains.kotlin:kotlin-compiler-embeddable` carries. It is third-party code: it is not
covered by the Xide license, it is not held to the warning, documentation and coverage gates of the Xide modules, and
it is changed only through `adapt.py`.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Upstream | <https://github.com/JetBrains/intellij-community> |
| Commit | `58066824746c383116366e6a876c08a06f15c718` |
| License | Apache License 2.0, as stated in the header of each source file; text in `LICENSES/Apache-2.0.txt` |
| Copyright | JetBrains s.r.o. and contributors |

The upstream `NOTICE.txt` at that commit reads:

```text
This software includes code from IntelliJ IDEA
Copyright (C) JetBrains s.r.o.
https://www.jetbrains.com/idea/
```

The file `LICENSE.txt` in the root of the upstream repository at that commit is not a source license: it is the
"JetBrains Open-Source Build Terms" for the binary builds of the IDE, and it states that those builds consist of
software subject to the Apache License 2.0. Xide takes source files, not a build, so the license of each file is the
one its own header names.

## Why the sources are copied

The published `groovy-psi` artifact depends on the complete IDE platform, several hundred megabytes of it, and it is
compiled against `com.intellij` packages. Xide uses the IntelliJ core inside the Kotlin embeddable compiler, where
those packages are relocated to `org.jetbrains.kotlin.com.intellij`. Lexing and parsing need about twenty files of
the plugin, so those files are compiled here against the relocated core.

## Layout

- `src/main` is generated by `adapt.py` from an upstream checkout. Every file there is an upstream file with the
  changes listed below, and starts with a line that says it was modified.
- `src/adapter` holds files written for Xide, under the Apache License 2.0. They replace upstream classes that
  depend on parts of the IDE this module does not have. Files that follow the shape of an upstream class name
  JetBrains in their copyright lines next to Progmasoft; the others are Progmasoft's alone.
- `adapt.py` performs the adaptation. Run `python adapt.py <checkout>` with a checkout at the commit above to
  regenerate `src/main`. Each replacement must match exactly once, so the script stops on an upstream change it no
  longer fits.

## Files taken from upstream

From `plugins/groovy/groovy-psi/gen/org/jetbrains/plugins/groovy/`, generated upstream by JFlex and Grammar-Kit:

- `lang/lexer/_GroovyLexer.java`
- `lang/parser/GroovyGeneratedParser.java`
- `lang/psi/GroovyElementTypes.java`

From `plugins/groovy/groovy-psi/src/org/jetbrains/plugins/groovy/`:

- `lang/lexer/GroovyLexerBase.java`, `GroovyTokenTypes.java`, `TokenSets.java`, `GroovyElementType.java`
- `lang/psi/GroovyTokenSets.java`
- `lang/parser/GroovyParser.java`, `GroovyElementTypes.java`, `GroovyStubElementTypes.java`,
  `GroovyEmptyStubElementTypes.java`, `parserUtils.kt`, `GroovyGeneratedParserUtils.kt`, `tokenSets.kt`
- `lang/parser/parsing/util/ParserUtils.java`
- `util/userDataHolder.kt`

From the platform, because the Kotlin embeddable compiler does not contain them:

- `platform/analysis-impl/src/com/intellij/lang/parser/GeneratedParserUtilBase.java`
- `platform/analysis-api/src/com/intellij/lang/BracePair.java`
- `platform/core-impl/src/com/intellij/psi/DummyBlockType.java`

From `plugins/groovy/groovy-psi/resources/messages/GroovyBundle.properties`, the five messages the parser sources
refer to, with unchanged texts, in `src/adapter/resources/messages/GroovyBundle.properties`.

## Changes to the upstream files

All files:

- A first line states that the file was modified and points here. The upstream copyright line is kept.
- References to `com.intellij.*` are relocated to `org.jetbrains.kotlin.com.intellij.*`. The three platform files
  above and the substitute `AnalysisBundle` keep their original package, because the classes do not exist in the
  relocated core.

`GeneratedParserUtilBase.java`:

- Completion variants are matched by a case-insensitive prefix instead of `CamelHumpMatcher`, which is an IDE class.
- Brace-aware error recovery is switched off, because there is no `LanguageBraceMatching` registry outside the IDE.
- The check `marker.isCollapsed()` is removed; the method is not part of the relocated core.

`DummyBlockType.java`: an import of `PsiReference` is added, which the original package provided implicitly.

`GroovyLexerBase.java`: `yybegin` is declared abstract, because `FlexLexer` of the relocated core does not declare it.

`ParserUtils.java`: the `@ParsingError` annotation, an IDE localisation marker, is removed from one parameter.

`parserUtils.kt`:

- The constant `CompletionUtilCore.DUMMY_IDENTIFIER_TRIMMED` is replaced by its value.
- An unused import of `ProgressManager` is removed.
- The body of `isBlockParseable` moves to `GroovyBlocks.java` in `src/adapter`; the Kotlin function calls it. The
  Kotlin compiler cannot resolve the supertypes of a Java source class of the same module that extends a relocated
  platform class.

`lang/psi/GroovyElementTypes.java`, `GroovyStubElementTypes.java`, `GroovyEmptyStubElementTypes.java`,
`lang/parser/GroovyElementTypes.java`:

- Element types that upstream declares with stub classes of the IDE are declared as `GroovyElementType`, and their
  static type becomes `IElementType`. The five block types keep their names and are defined in `src/adapter`.

## Substitutes written for Xide

`src/adapter` replaces these upstream classes with reduced ones:

- `GroovyLanguage`, `GroovyBundle`, `com.intellij.analysis.AnalysisBundle`: the language object and message lookup
  without the IDE's file-type, icon and localisation services.
- `GroovyLexer`: the generated lexer behind a merging adapter, without the look-ahead lexer of the IDE.
- `GrCodeBlockElementType` and the five block element types: eagerly parsed composite types instead of lazily
  reparseable ones.
- `GroovyBlocks`: the brace-balance check described above.
- `GroovyDocElementTypes`, `GroovyDocTokenTypes`: a documentation comment is one token; its content is not parsed.

## What is not included

The Groovy PSI element classes, stubs and indexes, resolution, type inference, inspections, formatting, and the
Groovydoc lexer and parser are not copied. The parser builds a syntax tree of generic PSI nodes with the upstream
element types.
